description: This file defines URL routing patterns for the Django e-commerce application, mapping URL paths to views and view functions for both public and admin functionalities.

classes.name: ItemDetailView
classes.description: Class-based view to display details of a specific product item.

classes.name: CheckoutView
classes.description: Class-based view to handle the checkout process.

classes.name: HomeView
classes.description: Class-based view for the homepage of the site.

classes.name: OrderSummaryView
classes.description: Class-based view for displaying the user's order summary.

classes.name: PaymentView
classes.description: Class-based view to handle payment processing.

classes.name: AddCouponView
classes.description: Class-based view for adding discount coupons.

classes.name: RequestRefundView
classes.description: Class-based view to request a refund.

methods.name: as_view
methods.description: Class method that converts the class-based view into a callable view function for URL routing.

methods.name: add_to_cart
methods.description: Function to add a product item to the shopping cart.

methods.name: remove_from_cart
methods.description: Function to remove an item from the shopping cart.

methods.name: remove_single_item_from_cart
methods.description: Function to remove a single unit of an item from the cart.

methods.name: admin_order_list
methods.description: Admin view to list all orders.

methods.name: admin_order_transition
methods.description: Admin view to transition the order state.
